parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group PEERS type exter.command: set protocols bgp group PEERS type external
set protocols bgp group PEERS type exter.explanation: 配置BGP协议的组类型为外部。

set protocols bgp group PEERS peer-as 10.command: set protocols bgp group PEERS peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group PEERS neighbor 1.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group PEERS neighbor 1.command: set protocols bgp group PEERS neighbor 10.1.1.2 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group PEERS neighbor 1.explanation: 配置BGP组的邻居地址及其地址族为IPv4单播。
